subject.title: Feature request: Coalesce interleaved text blocks into single outbound message

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in core delivery mode that coalesces or final-only-delivers assistant text across tool-interleaved agent turns, and what config shape should own it?
rationale: The source-backed UX problem is real, but solving it adds delivery policy and configuration surface that affects channel semantics, compatibility, and multiple related issue outcomes.

options.title: Add opt-in coalescing/final-only mode
options.body: Define a narrow agents or channel delivery setting that preserves metadata and coalesces or defers text across tool execution with tests for streamed and final payload paths.

options.title: Keep current visible boundaries
options.body: Preserve the current pre-tool/message boundaries and direct users toward prompt discipline, explicit message-tool modes, or narrower suppression fixes instead.

options.title: Split policy by outcome
options.body: Handle ordering, suppression, and one-message coalescing as separate maintainer decisions so related fixes do not accidentally choose a broad default.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in coalescing/final-only mode
recommendation.body: Define a narrow agents or channel delivery setting that preserves metadata and coalesces or defers text across tool execution with tests for streamed and final payload paths.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main ownership signal across the central reply pipeline and coalescer files.
